Until now, that is.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Regaining the Joy of Life
paragraphs: A few hours later, he awoke with his body covered in cold sweat. He decided to take a shower, but once in there, a big surprise awaited the young man as he glanced down.
A monster was staring back at him.

'Oh.'Kaiden's brain finally caught on to reality when he realized that this creature was the reason why he had gone through that horrible experience. He had gone from 5.5 inches (14cm) all the way to 9 inches (23cm). Well, according to the system. He wasn't in a battle-ready stance right now to check the validity of the system's statement, but his flaccid 'little' brother had already dwarfed his previous greatest treasure in size.
It was like a sleeping serpent. Ominous and ready to strike at a moment's notice.

'How will I go about this mission, though... Should I even listen to this thing in my mind? I just got a giant shaft for free, basically—save for the most excruciating pain I've felt in my life—what if I ignored this system going forward...? But, on the other hand, if this is not a nefarious, invasive parasite, it could be completely life-altering. It also doesn't have a penalty for failure, which earns a positive note in my book. I hate those novels where the MC is a slave of the system.'

Kaiden decided to at least complete the tutorial mission. If some supernatural creature wanted to harm him, he would've long since been dead. Thus, the system deserved some trust as far as he was concerned. He didn't want to throw this opportunity away just to ease his paranoia.

Furthermore, even if he couldn't become one of those epic awakened guys who could waltz into dungeons and slay horrendous monsters, this pornstar system was still better than nothing. He didn't want to remain a simple, ordinary existence, no matter the cost.

Thankfully, it was summer break, so he had all the free time he could ever want. Now that things have come to this, Kaiden started to become visibly excited at the prospect of his future career. As far as he was concerned, he either does this and lives the life he wants or becomes an economist who spends his life sitting behind a computer while looking at boring financial charts in an office cubicle until he turns into a 70-year-old frail man and is finally allowed to retire.
The choice was obvious.
Live hard like a rock star.
He cleaned himself and then went to grab his phone, exiting from the adult site and opening his banking application.

That was the depressing sight that welcomed him once he entered his credentials. Kaiden shed a manly tear at the view and then sighed dejectedly. He had so little money he would either have to take up a part-time job or move back with his family. The latter was something he truly didn't wish to do.

The friction back 'home' has been extremely high since he turned 20 years old, which is the final year in one's life when they have a chance to awaken. There had been some outliers, but they were one in a million. He was destined to remain a commoner until this strange day.

'It's time to go all-in by investing in myself and the future I might attain should I give it my all,'he decreed while nodding to himself resolutely. Kaiden opened his crypto account and sold all his scamcoins, soon receiving a transfer of $800.
'Finally, I don't need to watch these volatile pieces of shit going from red to green to red every other minute.' He couldn't help but feel somewhat liberated.

The first thing he decided to do was visit the nearest gym. While the 'getting fit' part of the mission could be achieved on his own, he thought that if he were to invest in himself, he might as well go all in and get state-of-the-art equipment and the guidance of a personal trainer.
His one-month timeframe given to complete the tutorial mission would fly by at a moment's notice, he had no time to fumble around by running laps in a park or watching Yout*be workout guides.
While it might be a weird dream for people, Kaiden truly wished to be a porn star. It was his dream job since encountering his first adult video. Well, besides being a mighty awakened, of course.
It was a perverted dream, yes, but he wasn't affected by the drawbacks of the job.

Kaiden liked attention, he loved gorgeous women, he wanted money, and he couldn't give a damn if his member was on tape for the whole world to see, especially now that it had become such a wonderful specimen. Haters could hate for all he cared.
He will be swimming in money and women, soaking in a luxury jacuzzi while snickering at the hate comments with a babe in each of his arms.'What a life that would be...'He thought wistfully.

With his unrealistic daydreaming completed for the time being, Kaiden soon arrived at the gym, Titan Training. He waltzed through the door and went straight to the reception. "Welcome to Titan Training! How may I be of assistance?" a cute girl he recognized from his college's campus greeted him enthusiastically.
"I wish to get a month's membership along with the guidance of a personal trainer."

"Understood! This is a high-end facility with many activities available inside, like Yoga classes, organized basketball games, and more. Our equipment is also the best available on the market, and our pricing reflects that. A monthly membership is $100 for the local students and $200 for the rest of the populace. Our trainers are highly professional individuals, so their help is fairly priced as well, with a one-hour session costing $80."
'Yikes. I will need to find a part-time job pronto. However, I heard great things about this place from the gym rats in my class. It should be worth the price, I suppose.'
"I would like to sign up with the student discount and pay for an hour as well."

"Understood!" She processed his registration, and he was in. The receptionist stood from the counter and followed after him, giving him a brief tour of the essentials, as she called them, which lasted for more than ten minutes. It was a big place.
"Liam, Aria, please come here," she called out suddenly, and two people who were doing lifts and squats abruptly ceased their activities and presented themselves.

Liam was a real hulking man with giant muscles, a clean shave, and a trendy hairstyle. His appearance screamed 'gym bro'. Friendly, dedicated, macho, and confident. He sported a simple trainer attire with shorts and nothing on his upper body besides a towel draped over his right shoulder. He looked to be about thirty years old.

On the contrary, Aria was a slender, youthful, and exceptionally beautiful girl with long silver hair. She was, without a doubt, the most beautiful woman Kaiden had ever seen, whether in real life or online. Her crystal blue eyes highlighted her flawless complexion, and her delicate features had a divine quality as if she had surpassed humanity and its many flaws.

The clothing she wore enhanced her attractiveness even more. She was dressed in close-fitting leggings that highlighted her ample curves, snapping to her body tightly. A sleeveless crop top exposed her stomach and shoulders for all to see, showcasing her slim waist and smooth skin.

The receptionist spoke up, bringing him out of the shock his brain suffered due to the girl's heavenly appearance. "Ehem. These two are Liam and Aria; they are both trainers who are free for the next hour. Please select one of them."
Kaiden was suddenly presented with an incredibly difficult decision.
A dilemma so great that ancient Greek philosophers would have to debate for a century straight and still not arrive at a clear-cut resolution.

Liam was the obvious choice for efficiency. Not only was he a man—thus, he could give him better tips and understand his struggles more—but he also had a decade on this girl by the look of things, meaning he likely had much more experience in their occupation. Aria, on the other hand, was simply his dream girl.

Furthermore, based on her body proportions, she was the typical female gym goer who worked mostly on her lady curves, so she truly didn't seem to be the ideal instructor for an ambitious man like him.

Once he examined Liam for a few seconds, who only nodded at him with a gentle smile, he looked at Aria once again. Sensing his attention was on her, she made an unprofessional gesture of puffing her bountiful chest out and nodding at him supportively.

'Damn...! This girl desperately wants my money, I can sense it.'He cursed inwardly while biting his inner lip until it bled. He had come to a decision.'Ancestors give me strength, for I refuse to be a simp! I'm here to gain muscles so that I can score chicks like her as a man, not as a paying customer! Once I'm fit enough, I will strike up a conversation with her and earn her heart the way I was meant to.'
Kaiden gave the beautiful silver-haired girl a final pained glance that was akin to a farewell before turning to Liam. "I would like you, Liam, to help me if possible."
"But of course, young man," he nodded with a nonchalant smile.

Once he rested a bit, Kaiden grabbed his phone and called the number Liam gave him.
"Bruno speaking," A deep voice answered.
"Hello, My name is Kaiden Ashborn, Liam sent me your number.
Said you were looking for a nightshift waiter.
Is this still the case?"
"Ashborn?
You wouldn't be..."
"I get that a lot, but sadly, I'm not part of that illustrious family.
I wouldn't be calling you for a night shift job if I were."
"Oh!
I guess you're right, haha!
Hey there, Kaiden.
Yes, we desperately need some help.
When can you hold a trial session?"
"Tonight."
"Amazing, that's what I like to hear.
Come to this address..."
Just as so, Kaiden had found himself employed for the first time in his life.
The work was hard, especially after how tiring his day had proven to be already.
Liam had put him through the wringer with his training, and continuously humping Evangeline—that's how he decided to name his new training partner—wasn't as easy as he had imagined either.
Kaiden was tired both physically and mentally.
In the end, he only accepted a four-hour shift instead of the six he thought of originally or the eight-hour one Bruno hoped he would accept.
Four hours a day would get him $60 guaranteed and most likely another $60 to $100 from tips.
Even with this new and more expensive lifestyle of his, he only really needed to worry about food and paying for Liam's training.
At least as far as completing the system's tutorial mission was concerned.
If he wanted to leave a good impression, it might not be a bad idea to dress up for the casting at the agency, though he wasn't sure if that would be appreciated.
He might end up being completely out of place.
Yeah, thinking about it a bit more, he decided that he shouldn't buy a proper salaryman-style suit but something more trendy than what was available to him currently.
A visit to a hairstylist would also do him some good.
Kaiden undressed from his normal streetwear and put on his exercising attire.
He had slept like a log after he finished his shift in Bruno's bar.
After waking up, he cooked himself an omelet and drank a protein shake, then went to the gym straight away.
His motivation had been through the roof ever since the system gave him the tutorial mission.
Today, he wasn't going to meet with Liam but do upper body exercises by himself the two of them went over yesterday.
Kaiden's muscles were aching, but he knew that as long as he was careful, he could strain them a bit.
He had to build up resistant muscles.
He placed his belongings in a locker and exited the changing room.
However, before he could even take a step, the beautiful trainer girl, Aria, was waiting for something.
Kaiden found it very strange, but since there was not much of a reason for her to be standing in front of an otherwise empty male locker room, he guessed that she was here for him.
Thus, he walked to her and said, "Can I help you with something, Aria?"
The silver-haired girl glanced around carefully before replying, "I just wanted to ask how your training was with Liam."
Kaiden frowned for a second but decided to give her the benefit of the doubt.
"Very good.
I have no complaints."
Hearing his comment, Aria's eyes lost a bit of their luster as her shoulders slumped, and she sighed, "I see."
Seeing her reaction, Kaiden knew exactly what this was about.
"Isn't trying to poach your colleague's clientele very rude?" he asked, more so out of curiosity towards seeing her response than trying to be an annoying moral compass.
He couldn't care less what she did to get trainees paying for her time.
It was a dog-eat-dog world, especially since the arrival of the apocalypse.
It added an extra element of uncertainty to everyone's lives, making people value the present more than ever.
"No, I wasn't trying to do that!
Liam is an experienced trainer; I was just wondering how his client felt after a session with him!" Aria's response was a torrent of words that spewed out of her mouth as if she were a rapper.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Offer
paragraphs: Kaiden smirked at her but decided to let it go. She clearly had her own issues, and he wasn't interested in adding more to her plate. "Thanks for asking. I feel sore all over my body, but I know that he will help me reach my goal, so I'm feeling very motivated."

Aria sighed with great relief when she heard he wasn't going to seriously accuse her. Then, she glanced at him again, "Soreness isn't good. Do you maybe want me to help you stretch?" This time, she gave him a beautiful smile, but he felt the desperation that was badly hidden behind it.

Kaiden grimaced inwardly. Liam told him yesterday that trainers had no fixed salary and only got paid when they were on the clock with a client. Thus, her offer was either purely out of the goodness of her heart, or she still wanted to poach him. He wasn't born yesterday, so he knew that chances were that it was the latter.
"Sure, but I'm not going to be changing trainers, and that's a fact."
Aria sighed dejectedly once again, "I'm sorry, but I just remembered that I have something to do..."

Kaiden chuckled, and, to be honest, he felt very proud because not only were his instincts proven to be spot on, but he managed to resist her overwhelming feminine charms as well. "Don't worry about it. I don't know why you need money so desperately, and I'm not going to ask. With that being said, I have been presented with an opportunity you might want to jump on just like I did."

Seeing the interest in her eyes, Kaiden knew she was interested. "Liam had introduced me to a bar that needs serving staff during the night shift. I could introduce you if you would like me to. For the record, the owner is almost as ripped as Liam and looks a lot meaner, so you don't have to worry about guests being touchy, he's there throughout the entirety of the night shift."

Her expression changed as she heard his offer. At the beginning of it, she was miserable, then curious, after which she turned hopeful. Her near-lifeless eyes sparkled a tiny bit as she said, "I-I think I might take you up on your offer. Can you maybe introduce me personally? I'm not good with phone calls, and Liam already looks very scary to me, so if this guy is even worse, then..."
Kaiden didn't expect such a bombshell, who worked a very social job, to act so shyly, but he had no issues with accommodating her request.
"Sure. I'm going there at 10 pm. Is that good for you?"
"Yes. Should be. I mean, I usually go to sleep at that time, but I need the money, so..." Aria responded wryly.
Kaiden didn't react to what she said, instead simply deciding to ask for her phone number so that he could send her the details. She had no objections and happily typed it into his phone.

Although it wasn't for the reason he wanted, Kaiden finally scored the number of a gorgeous girl. As far as he was concerned, it was a big achievement. A conversation that started as a short, business-oriented messaging session may end up going a long mile.

Anyhow, this month wasn't about picking up girls but training. Kaiden wasn't going to desperately chat her up like a horndog. Her mind was clearly not worried about dating either but making money anyway. He would be shot down mercilessly, he could tell instinctively.

Kaiden instead grabbed his earphones, put them in his ear, and began playing some blood-pumping battle OSTs. They were perfect to get him into the mood that was required to torture his body for a better tomorrow.

Once he was done with the gym, Kaiden went home and cooked a chicken and rice meal with a serving of greens on the side. He had preferred stuff like pizza and burgers, but he knew that they were unhealthy. His previous self didn't care much because he had no goals and was just going through the motions of life like a robot.
Now, however, with an amazing, exciting goal in mind, he had no trouble eating healthy. All he needed was motivation.
After cooking his meal, he rested and decided to do some research on the 'Untainted Holes' studio that the system wanted him to audition for.
He checked their website first and saw that all content was behind a paywall. For now, Kaiden read through the front page of their website.

As the system had alluded to, and as the name of the company implied, they specialized in 'teen' porn, where young adult women would get a big sum of money for agreeing to lose their virginity on camera.

Now that he thought about it on a deeper level, a new emotion had surged within Kaiden's heart. He knew that if he were to take the virginity of a girl, whether during a porn shoot or not, he wouldn't be able to take it well if she went on to have sex with others.

He wasn't cold-hearted enough not to develop at least some minor feelings towards such a girl. It was one thing if he had a video shoot with an established actress, but if he was going to be the first man in a woman's life...

As for the company's business model, after the initial shoot, the women would typically go on to get contracted with the studio for a few years, where they would continue shooting 'teen' porn—likely for a much lower compensation than the initial offer—after which they would be let go.

Naturally, they were free to not sign a long-term contract after the initial shoot, as that was only a one-off deal, but a lot decided to anyway. If they were down on their luck to this degree, then chances were, the couple thousand dollars they get for their debut video wouldn't be enough to change their lives. Thus, many had to become professionals.
Of course, it was also possible that they were like him, who simply didn't care about having their bodies shown off on the net and were happy to become rich by having fun in bed.
It wasn't a bad idea in his mind, the nature of the occupation was just clashing against the traditional values of society.

As for the exclusivity of the site, it wasn't much. They uploaded short videos that consisted of a few minute-long clips to all the big, free sites as a form of cheap promotion. Therefore, he could watch some content without having to pay.

He did just that as he checked a couple of videos and saw that the studio was professional with their equipment, location, filming crew, and all that jazz. However, their views weren't all that high for some reason.
He also found that this studio was part of a much bigger adult filming giant, who were the owners of the company. XXXVidz was the name, and they owned multiple smaller studios like this one.
"Well, this much research is enough for now..." Kaiden muttered, then stood to stretch his sore limbs and leave the apartment.
Although he didn't know it yet, it was time to once again meet his friendly neighbor!

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Childhood Rival
paragraphs: As he stepped outside of his small dorm room and turned the key to lock it, he came face to face with David. David was his dorm neighbor and a person he had known since they were in kindergarten, which meant that there were roughly 19 years of shared history between the two.
One might expect them to be good friends or at least supportive acquaintances.
That was far from the truth.

In kindergarten, David brought in his favorite toy to play with after lunch when they would have free activities and started boasting about how cool it was. Kaiden got jealous and decided to break it because he didn't have such a badass toy robot.

Naturally, David got mad and (after a lot of crying) snitched on him to their teacher, resulting in Kaiden having to apologize, his parents buying David a replica of the toy, and he also got a lot of flack for it at home from his father.

The young Kaiden knew that he was in the wrong but didn't care much, so despite his (forced) apology, their relationship never got any better. In elementary school, they were rivals on getting the best grades, in middle school, they competed to be better than the other at basketball, and in high school, they were crushing on the same girl (both got rejected).
Now that they were in college, all their rivalries reached new heights when Kaiden beat David's highest rank in a competitive game when he reached Gold 3.
Yes, they both were very average gamers.
David was also the guy who shouted at him to shut up while banging his walls when he was getting his penis torn to shreds and restructured by the system.
Kaiden raised an eyebrow when he examined David, who was smugly smirking at him. It wasn't hard to decipher why he was in such a jolly mood; a girl was endearingly latched onto his arm.
"Kaiden, my good friend. How have you been?" David inquired haughtily in a posh tone as if they were wealthy business partners seeing each other after returning from a holiday trip to Hawaii.
The pornstar wannabe, instead of entertaining him with an answer, decided to check the girl out.
She definitely wasn't a monumental victory.

Calling her chubby would be generous; she was just plain fat. Though going by modern standards, she wasn't close to being morbidly rotund, just 'plus-sized.' She had dark hair, freckles on her cheeks, and quite small breasts compared to the rest of her overwhelming curves. She wasn't a complete monster, though, Kaiden would honestly give her a score of 2.5 out of 10.
Just barely fuckable if one was truly desperate or had enough alcohol present in their system to remove all of their inhibitions.
"Are you done checking my girl out? Meet Becky. We ran into each other on campus, and it was love at first sight. Becky, meet Kaiden, a guy I have known since kindergarten."
Kaiden nodded to the girl before amicably offering his congratulations to the pair. "Hey, nice to meet you. Kudos to both of you."

He knew that showing any signs of care, be that jealousy or anger, would be playing right into what David wanted him to do. Yes, his girl wasn't hot, not at all, but she was still a girl. It didn't feel good to be the loser of the race to score a chick, but... Kaiden was never desperate enough to go for ugly gals like this one. He shot for the stars with each attempt of his, but like Icarus, his wings always melted before he could reach the sun.
"Hey. David told me some things about you," she greeted him back with a wry smile.
"All good things, I imagine..." he chuckled, to which she grimaced, letting Kaiden know that David had been trash-talking him. Well, not that he cared.

Sadly, David was a rather smart guy, or at least academically gifted, as he was one of the top students in their economics major. Kaiden got disillusioned with the degree and wasn't giving it his all to get good grades, so he was now the loser on both the personal and professional end of their nerdy rivalry.
"Well, enjoy yourselves, I'm off to train."
"Bye, Kaiden. It was nice meeting you."

"Sure, man. Have fun," David said lastly, but as they went past each other, he brushed his shoulder into Kaiden's and leaned in to whisper, "I'm going to be the one who loses his V card first, broski. It will happen today. You're making beating you in all aspects of life too easy nowadays... I'm honestly starting to get bored."
Kaiden paused for a moment and glanced back towards the retreating form of the pair as they went into David's dorm room together.
'I could've lost it ages ago if I lowered my standards to a hippo, you fuckface.'

Kaiden could've said this out loud and probably even come out victorious from their ensuing argument, but he was too classy of a guy to say this in front of Becky. She didn't deserve to be berated just because the two men had beef with each other.
Kaiden knew that ugly girls like her tended to be heavily insecure about their looks, so he could really hurt her heart if he were to speak back to David in that scenario.
The war between them didn't need to have innocent casualties.

In the next moment, he just shrugged his shoulders. Kaiden had much bigger things to worry about, and there was a chance that he could take a gorgeous girl's virginity by the end of the month if he succeeded in the tutorial mission of the system and get paid while doing so.'Play the long game, Kaiden.'He reassured himself, then stepped out of the dorm and went for a walk.
He came back to his room after an hour.
There was still a lot of time left until his shift at Bruno's bar, so he slumped into his bed and then opened his systemic interface.
Ever since the apocalypse, all humans had access to this status window that displayed their relevant information.
However, for non-awakened people, meaning the commoners, this window didn't display much. In Kaiden's case, it used to be as such;
[Name: Kaiden Ashborn]
[Class: -]
[Level: -]
However, ever since he managed to slip on the banana peel like a certified boss, a few lines were added.
[Name: Kaiden Ashborn]
[Rank: 0 - Worm]
[Class: -]
[Level: -]
[Tutorial Mission: Stop Being Pathetic, Fuck Virgins For A Living!]
[Side Quest: Training Arc]

When a commoner awakened, they would receive a class, which meant that despite getting a system, he still wasn't an awakened—since he didn't have a class. Classes were categorized into tiers, going from F to S in most cases.

Awakened were soft-locked regarding their potential depending on the class they got. Someone with an F-ranked class would quickly fall behind one that got an S-ranked one if they put in the same amount of effort and had the same amount of innate talent and general luck.
Levels served as a measuring tool of progression. Awakeners had to kill dungeon monsters or other awakened in order to gain levels, which would make them stronger.

The day has come; today, Kaiden will visit the location the casting agent indicated.
He dressed in his recently acquired suit and visited the barber once again. Right now, he was sitting in a taxi. The place was about 20 minutes away by car.
Once there, he quickly found the exact location thanks to Go*gle Maps, and when he stepped inside, a small reception area welcomed Kaiden.
He walked up to the older woman sitting behind the reception desk. "Hi, I'm here for the casting."
She raised her vision from her computer screen to examine him. "Welcome. Identification papers, please."
He handed his ID over, and she checked something in their database. "Found you. Take this list, read it over, and give it back to me once completed."
Kaiden accepted the paper and the pen she gave him and then began studying it.
It was a comprehensive paper that asked a lot of questions. His basic information, sexual preferences, safety declarations, consent to be filmed, payment information, and more.

He began filling the forms out. For the stage name, he chose 'Maverick'. It sounded cool. As for the STD test, he'd already done it beforehand. Though with his [Immune Cock] passive skill, it wasn't relevant.

As for scene preferences, he strictly chose straight scenes with either a single girl or multiple, though he made sure to indicate that he would only do it if he was the sole male present. For everything else, he declined.
The receptionist gave it a read-over, then nodded, folding the paper and stashing it away. "Go ahead," she said while gesturing towards a double door.
Once he did as instructed, he froze in place from shock. Kaiden was unable to accept that what he was seeing was indeed reality.
"K-K-Kaiden?!" A feminine voice yelped with sheer shock evident in her tone.
"Aria..." Kaiden greeted the girl in a disbelieving whisper once his dazed state of mind subsided enough for his brain to reboot itself.
The girl couldn't meet his eyes and only replied a meek, "Please kill me..."
"You know this dude?" a guy spoke up haughtily.

Multiple people were seated in sofas close to each other. The one who spoke up seemed like a certified background character. Brown hair, brown eyes, nothing memorable. Kaiden knew he would forget about his existence as soon as the guy wasn't in front of him.

Aria didn't bother responding—or rather couldn't, due to her extreme amount of shame. "Finally, someone good-looking. I was starting to get depressed by these mob characters." a woman's voice could be heard this time, the only one besides Aria in the group.
"Watch your tongue, whore!" all three guys shouted at her at the same time, but she didn't care at all and instead grinned at them mockingly.
"The truth hurts, doesn't it?"
"You better hope I'm not partnered up with you, or you will scream under me like a bitch!" The first loser decreed.
"Ooh. I'm shaking in my boots. Please, spare me! ... Anyway, Aria, would you mind introducing me to this gentleman?"
"No. Please leave me alone." The silver-haired girl retreated into her mental shell, refusing to accept reality.
"Well, I will just have to do it myself then," the energetic woman decreed, stood from her seat, and walked up to him.

paragraphs: Kaiden took this moment to examine this strange girl.

Her pink hair would've already made her stand out from any crowd, but that was only the icing on the cake in her case. It was her grin that truly caught his attention—playful and full of attitude like she was constantly on the verge of saying something so provocative she would be canceled on Twitt*r within a moment's notice.

A black choker adorned her neck, and she wore a slightly oversized off-the-shoulder sweater that hinted at her hourglass figure, paired with black, skin-tight pants that highlighted her thick thighs. Her whole appearance screamed confidence and sexiness. She also sported the largest, most bountiful breasts and shapely butt Kaiden had ever seen.
"You're even cuter up close. I will ask the strict casting lady so that we are paired together."
Kaiden couldn't help but chuckle under his breath due to the pink-haired woman's announcement. This girl was different, but not in a bad way. Her energy was refreshing.
"Nice to meet you. I'm Kaiden," He greeted the eccentric ball of energy.
"Oh! Where are my manners? Nyx, nice to meet you." Instead of shaking his hand, she hugged him tightly.
Now that her chest was this close, Kaiden noticed something after he got over how comforting her large breasts being mashed up against him were. Her heart was beating incredibly fast.

'I understand now... She's pretending. This enthusiastic and brash act is her way of dealing with stress. There's no way a young girl would be this chill about losing her virginity on camera for a stack of cash. This front of hers is just a defense mechanism.'
He thought that Nyx might be like him, someone who didn't mind being filmed or even wanted it, but no. Her heartbeat belied her true feelings. She was scared like a lost kitten.

Once she disengaged, the pink-haired beauty grabbed his hand and began dragging him towards the group. All guys were dressed as common lowlives; one was even in a Nik* trainer outfit. No wonder this girl latched onto the sole promising young man who appeared in front of her.

"Make way, losers," she growled at the trio of men who were eyeing Kaiden with eyes promising nothing but a brutal beating. They didn't wish to give him room, and the only sofa was that of Nyx's from which she stood to greet him.
"Hm. Alright. We've got no other choice then..." Nyx murmured, then gestured for Kaiden to sit in her seat, and then she placed herself in his lap.
"You're a bold one..." Kaiden commented, playing along with her act.
"Hehe..."
"So what's the procedure? Have you guys passed the test?" he asked no one in particular, but it was Nyx who replied instantly.

"Me and Aria already passed. Another girl is being checked right now. For us, it was only the strict lady examining if our hymen were intact or not. Supposedly, we get double the money if it is. These losers are waiting for their turn."
"I see," Kaiden nodded.
Just then, the door opened, and a glasses-wearing lady came out, followed by a short girl. "Kaiden?!"
"You know each other?" the older, strict-looking woman asked curiously.
"Yeah..." he chuckled wryly. "What are the chances? Two out of three. Nice seeing you, Luna."

"I'm sorry... I had no other choice..." she whispered dejectedly with an extremely pained expression as if she had just completely betrayed him, though as to what she was apologizing for exactly, he didn't know. It was not like she was his girlfriend or anything. In the end, they didn't even manage to go on an initial date.

"Don't worry about it. I'm sure you have had your reasons," Kaiden replied amicably, not wanting the depressed girl to begin bawling her eyes out right here and now, as by the look of things, that was exactly what she was about to do.
When he met this woman in the adult shop, she had such a bright, fun personality, but here she looked just straight-up suicidal.
"So am I the only one who didn't know you beforehand?!" Nyx shouted with disbelief before eyeing him suspiciously, "Are you a playboy?"
"No, actually, I'm a virgin too," he revealed nonchalantly, causing all three men to snort at him and begin throwing insults his way.
"Hah! He says he's a virgin! The nice dress won't help you get a role here, retard!"
"Do you even know where to aim with your little pecker? He will miss the hole entirely, hahaha!"
"Dude, just go home. You're embarrassing yourself."

Compared to the losers, the three women all glanced at him with newfound interest. Not only was he dressed very well, but he also conducted himself like a normal person, and he was inexperienced, just like them to boot. Whoever would be paired up with him was certainly going to become the 'winner,' they all thought.
Yes, each girl was supposed to be paired with a different guy for variety's sake.

The glasses-wearing woman had enough of the crude insults; she spoke up, "Next, boys' turn. Kaiden Ashborn." She then glanced at her paper with obvious befuddlement in her gaze while double-checking something.
"I'm not from that family, lady," Kaiden commented, knowing exactly what she was surprised about. She nodded in response and sighed with relief.
"Aww, the nerd goes first? But we were here before him." They objected but were shot down with extreme coldness in the boss woman's tone.
"Don't care, didn't ask, also; shut the fuck up."

"Damn, this lady do be cold tho! It's suddenly freezing in here!" the second jeered while the third hugged himself with his arms and began shaking violently while giving off *brrrrr* sound effects as if he was about to freeze to his death.

Nyx reluctantly got out of his lap and strengthened her grip around his palm for a moment. "You have to pass! I desperately need the money, but I would honestly rather end my life than give my first time to any of these thugs."
He nodded to reassure her while declaring, "I'll do my best; you have my word."

Just like her moniker implied, she had almost complete control over the shadows, which meant that should she wish to, Vespera could easily murder all four of them with a single thought of hers.
The Shadow Monarch's mere presence was enough to command the utmost attention and respect without a single word spoken.
She had long, straight, pitch-black hair, and her eyes were a deep shade of red, like two burning coals, and were sharp, distant, and calculating.
Vespera's skin was sickly pale, contrasting strongly against the dark, tailored suit she wore.
The suit fit her perfectly, emphasizing her tall, lean figure, which further accentuated her imposing aura.
There was a sense of elegance in her movements, but it was a deadly, untouchable elegance, like watching a predator—graceful but always ready to strike.
Everything about Vespera screamed power, from her piercing gaze to the way she held herself.
There was no warmth in her expression, no softness—just cold, calculated dominance that made it clear that she was painfully aware of just how absurdly strong she was.
Despite the girls' straight-up hyperventilating reaction, Kaiden was eerily calm.
After all, he's known this woman for 22 years, 23 if we were to count the time he spent in her womb.
"Hello, mother."

chapters.title: Chapter 38: Vespera Ashborn
paragraphs: "Hello, mother."
"Kaiden." She nodded in greeting.
"What?!" Nyx screamed first, followed by Aria's "H-h-h-huh?!" Luna just slumped back into her chair as she was on the brink of fainting.
Without waiting to be invited, Vespera took a seat at the table. She completely ignored the trio and only focused on her son.
"How have you been?" She asked in a cold, emotionless tone.

Kaiden wasn't disturbed by her distanced antics since she's been like this forever. As for how Vespera could awaken despite being over twenty years of age the moment the mana apocalypse hit? No, she wasn't one of the lucky few who awakened later in their life. When the initial mana boom happened ten years ago, anyone had about a 15% chance to awaken, no matter their age. Vespera was one such person.
"I'm finally happy after years of being depressed."
"Good," she replied curtly.
"I got a gym membership and have a personal trainer; I even worked hard as a waiter in a bar."
"I know."
Her creepy admission might've been outrageous, but he was used to it. She liked to be in control. Kaiden did not doubt that she was also aware of... "I also landed a role in a film."
Vespera pulled her suit's sleeve slightly up on her right wrist, revealing a tasteful, elegant wristwatch.

After glancing at it for a single moment, she parted her lips and began monologuing in her monotone, cold voice. "You finished shooting the third and final video exactly 78 minutes and 12 seconds ago and received a respectable offer from Zadie Crowe, one of the top managers of XXXVidz. Her favorite color is blue, flower type is jasmine, pet animal is dog, movie is Pride and Prejudice, and her hobby is playing competitive chess—just in case you want to make a good impression on her.

You've managed to sexually dominate Lirael Port, also known by her stage name 'Angel.' She's been raving about you to multiple adult actress acquaintances of hers over Whats*pp on her phone. It's the newest release of the Sams*ng Galaxy series she bought on a whim during her Vacation to Turkey last summer, but she is angry with herself for not getting an Iph*ne instead because she thinks it has a better camera, which would let her take better pictures of her two hamsters of the Winter White Dwarf subspecies. Their names are Nibbles and Peanut, and she has a dedicated Instagr*m handle, @WinterWhiteSupremacy, where she exclusively posts images and videos of them.

As a result of your month-long efforts of training your body in the gym called 'Titan Training,' as well as with the three adult toys you bought from 'Velvet Desires'—two of which were sold to you by the young lady to your right—and the third by the owner's deadbeat son who is in $60,000 debt due to his gambling addiction, you won the bet that you made with the aforementioned company executive, who then kicked out the Brown family's triplet brothers who were expelled from high school all on the same day when they attempt raped their classmate on the school's rooftop.

They spent the rest of their childhood in the local youth detention center. They were born to a junkie mother who overdosed two years and thirteen days ago and a domestically abusive father who has been in jail for fourteen years and will remain there for ten more at the very least due to the murder charges he was sentenced for, letting you star with the 19 years old Luna Aster, the 19 years old Aria Levander, and the 20 years old Nyx Cosmos during their debut under the direction of the 'Untainted Holes' adult filming studio."
"Well, you most certainly have done your homework..." Kaiden chuckled wryly.
"Indeed," she nodded for the third time.
"Why are you here today, Mother?" he asked, knowing full well that it would be better if he got the answer out of this eccentric woman as soon as possible.
"To disown you."

"I see..." Kaiden sighed, expecting that something like this could be awaiting him. After all, the Ashborn family was one of the most prestigious names in the United States of America. They couldn't have one of their mainline members be a pornstar. Vespera and his father were the co-guild leaders of 'New Dawn,' one of the mightiest guilds in the nation.

"I've had a subordinate hack into the studio's database and change your name. From now on, you're officially Kaiden Grey. Here are your new identification papers. I also had your bank accept this change without raising any issues on your end," Vespera announced before reaching into her coat and pulling out an envelope, which she slid across the table to land perfectly in front of him.

"Thanks," Kaiden accepted the envelope. He wasn't at all surprised that she strongarmed one of the biggest financial institutions in the country to immediately change his name in their system without asking any questions. It was such a small thing for her that she likely didn't even have to be present for it—just a call from her assistant should've been more than enough.

Afterward, Vespera didn't say anything to him and instead stared deep into his eyes for a good dozen seconds. Once she had her fill, her features contorted just for a moment before she stood from her seat. The Shadow Monarch turned and began walking toward the exit. Before she left, she stopped at the door and said, "Have a nice life, son."
"You too, moth- no. Have a nice life, Vespera. Also, stop spying on this stranger from now on. I don't wanna give the police a heart attack by asking for a restraining order against Vespera Ashborn."

Kaiden's words made the woman flinch once again, but she didn't turn around. Soon, her visage was no longer visible, leaving three flabbergasted girls in her wake and a nonchalant man who grabbed a salmon nigiri and popped it into his mouth, then began chewing it.
"What the fuck happened just now?" Luna mouthed.
"You said you weren't from that family!" Aria shouted accusatorily.
Kaiden shrugged his shoulders, "I lied."

"But why? Why become a pornstar when you have immeasurable wealth and power available to you at your fingertips? Your Mother is the fucking Shadow Monarch, for Christ's sake! You should be one of the most privileged existences on Earth!" Nyx shouted, desperately trying to understand why he would throw all of it away.
Kaiden placed his chopsticks down on the table, turning more serious. He took a deep breath and began.

"Because I hated my life at 'home'. Maybe I'm just a snot-nosed rebellious brat in the eyes of people like you three who must've experienced true misfortune, but I couldn't breathe in our grand mansion filled with extravagant luxuries. I was ridiculed, badmouthed, and looked down upon for being the only commoner among my four siblings."

He stopped for a second only to shake his head dejectedly, "What are the chances? My father and mother awakened during the initial mana boom, followed by my two brothers and two sisters, leaving me as the single ordinary bum in the family. My younger brothers bullied me, my older sister treated me like trash, and my father outright refused to acknowledge my existence.

As if that wasn't enough, I was constantly bombarded with news of their most recent accomplishments in the dungeons and other competitions while I was on my knees, begging the heavens and all that is holy to awaken me as well. When I couldn't bear leading such a miserable life any longer, I moved to the college dorm and lived away from the world of the awakened, letting me finally breathe. Then something happened, something I invited you three to talk about, and I decided to follow my dreams of becoming a pornstar. That's my story."
A long minute of silence descended on the restaurant's private room as the trio did their absolute best to digest his words.

Aria was the first to speak up. "Still, how could a mother do this to her child?! She could've just deleted the recordings, easily strongarmed Zadie into maintaining silence, and just given your rebellious butt some good spanking filled with motherly love! Instead, she just disowns her son?! What the hell?!"
"She did it for me."
Confusion welcomed his statement.

chapters.title: Chapter 39: Revelation
paragraphs: "She did it for me."
"W-what do you mean?"

"Vespera and Alice, my younger sister, were the only two who treated me like a human being. Vespera always respected my choices and freedom; she might've even been happy when I moved away from home because she knew that I was suffering there.

Vespera must've already known weeks ago that I planned to star in today's filming, yet made no move to interject, leaving the decision up to me. It's my life, after all. However, my decision would've enraged my father, brothers, and elder sister. Vespera disowned me to save me from having to face their wrath, knowing full well that they would be out to get revenge for sullying their prestigious name and silence me for eternity."
"This is just too much for me..." Nyx stated. Her brain was officially fried.
"Yeah. I did call Kaiden our prince a few times as a jest, but to think that he was the modern-day equivalent of a prince all along..." Luna voiced her thoughts with pure disbelief.
"Are you fine, Kai? Let me know if I can do anything to cheer you up. Anything," Aria said with worried eyes while caressing his hand supportively.

"I'm fine. Even if I knew for certain that this was going to be the result of my actions, I would've done the same if I were to be returned in time. I got to meet you three lovely girls, and I'm as happy as I've ever been. The Ashborn family name did nothing for me.

I even took out a student loan instead of asking for an allowance because I wanted to be independent. Now I have no other choice but to stand on my own two legs, and I honestly feel liberated as well as excited to experience what the future has in store for me," Kaiden stated with a jovial smile.
Three pairs of eyes scrutinized his face's every little detail, searching for signs of deception or plain untruthfulness, but they found no such thing.
"It might be selfish of me to say, but I'm also delighted with your decision, Kaiden," Nyx spoke up after a short while.
"I have to agree with Miss Mommy Milkers over here. You quite likely saved all of us today. At the very least, our mental health for sure." Luna agreed.
Aria stood from her seat and rushed over to him, then jumped into his embrace. "They are right! Truly, thank you!"
"There's no need to thank me for anything."
"Shut up, you dummy! Take this. Say aaa..." Aria shut him up, comfortably seated herself on his lap, grabbed a nigiri, and lifted it to his mouth.

The purple-haired beauty wasn't all too happy with the images her eyes were forwarding to her brain. "Didn't you say guys don't like clingy girls? Also, only normies eat sushi with their hands. You didn't even dip it in soy sauce... Yikes."
"Hmph! I'm a normie then, sue me, you rude goblin child. Also, Kaiden deserves some adoration today; it's not me being clingy."
"Haaah?!" Luna roared furiously. "Goblin child? What the fuck?! Take it back right this instant!"
"You shouldn't badmouth these cute creatures, Aria," Nyx muttered while Go*gling what a goblin was.
"They kidnap human women and breed them en masse," Luna informed the pink girl, who often found herself underprepared to understand her generation's internet knowledge and references.

"Oh. Never mind then." Kaiden couldn't help but laugh inwardly at the plump beauty's adorable antics. She seemed by far the wildest out of the trio just based on appearances, but she was often the tamest. Her being unable to grasp most Gen Z references was also very cute in his eyes.
"Stupid bitches...!" The petite beauty growled.

"Girls," Kaiden began, drawing their attention to him. It was time to turn serious. "You might remember the text I sent this morning. I have big plans for the future, and I want all three of you to be part of it."
"It feels like you're asking us to become your lovers!" Aria giggled cutely.
"You could say that," Kaiden nodded, causing three gasps to sound from three different lips.
"That's a bit..." Aria gasped with shock. "Too much too soon. I do respect the ambitiousness, though," Luna finished for the silver-haired beauty.

Polygamy was frowned upon in the modern world, at least the western part of it, so it was hard for any 21st-century woman to accept being part of a harem. It made them feel somewhat lesser, as if they weren't good enough to satisfy their man by themselves. Sharing also often felt plain wrong and was hard on their sensitive hearts.

Nyx seemed to harbor different thoughts. "After having our videos spread over the net, it would be difficult to find a good man, I would say. You, as another pornstar, might be my best husband candidate. Even if I find a guy who says he doesn't mind, the stigma would always be there."
"Still..."
Kaiden then suddenly spoke up, grabbing the girls out of their frenzied thoughts. "I want to trust the three of you. Can I do that?"
"Sure!" Aria nodded, soon followed by the others.
"What I'm about to say is the greatest secret of my life. If you blabber about it, I will find myself strapped under a surgeon's scalpel as he cuts me open while I'm still alive."
His serious tone made all of them understand the severity of the situation.
"You can trust me." Luna was the first to speak up as she looked deep into his eyes.
"I would never betray your trust, Kai!" Aria followed up.
"I will take your secret to the grave with me," Nyx decreed.
After staring at each girl for a few seconds, he nodded, happy with the trustworthy eyes he was seeing.
"Give me your phones and any other electronics you have on you. Give me your bags as well while you're at it."
They found his instructions strange but ended up listening since his attitude made them all curious.
Kaiden stood and brought everything to the reception, where he asked they be safeguarded for a bit, then went back. Now, there was no way to listen in on them through the gadgets.

If Vespera had a way even now, then he couldn't do much, but if Kaiden were to be forced to tell his secret to someone outside this room, his choice would be her, so he didn't mind all too much. Vespera was not his enemy and never would be.
"About a month ago, I broke my neck." Kaiden dove straight into the nitty-gritty of his story.
"?" Questioning glances welcomed his statement.
"I should be dead, yet I'm not. The reason for that is simple: a strange system had invaded my soul and resurrected me. I don't know how or why, but what matters is that it happened."
"Kaiden..." Luna began voicing her distaste for his unfunny jokes, but then a screen suddenly emerged in front of her. A blue, transparent screen.

[Valkyries]

1. [Monster Girl Subjugator] (S-tier)
2. [Immune Cock] (D-tier)
3. [Remove Her Inhibitions] (E-tier)
Multiple frightened yelps welcomed the systemic interface's materialization.
"You're an awakened?!" Nyx cried.

All that is to say—personal might as awakened people, sex as very compatible partners, and content creation with our unique personalities and existences as both awakened and pornstars would come together to create a cycle of people endlessly flocking to all kinds of content we create. The strong rule the world, and we have a chance to become rich, influential, and powerful in one fell swoop. I consider this a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity."

Luna started playing with her two locks of purple hair, visibly deep in thought. "Hmm... The pink bimbo's earlier claim about us not being able to live like normal women after today's filming is true for sure. If that's the case, why not just embrace it with our entire being and go all in...? As Kaiden said, we would get a lot of haters, but as long as we support each other, I think that's more than enough. As they say, having a few true friends is much better than numerous shallow ones. Furthermore, if we do become strong, we will have many enemies anyway. I'm sure lots of people would rejoice if Scarlet or Vespera were to die or have an ugly downfall."

Kaiden was happy to see the rather troublesome girl call Aria and Nyx her true friends. He'd noticed that even during their biggest clashes, there wasn't an ounce of hatred in any of them. They were just being playful in their feisty way.

Luna then shyly glanced at Kaiden before averting her gaze and adding, "What's more, I'm reluctant to admit it, but I didn't dislike what happened today. I would even go as far as to admit I enjoyed it greatly. Just think about it: how fun would our lives be? We could even move in together to a faraway, empty location and live as we want. I could have my streams, Aria could do her makeup tutorials or whatever she enjoys, and Nyx... I guess you're only good for getting your twin towers demolished by Kaiden's girthy airplane. We could also party together, clear dungeons, and maybe even make our guild one day."

"Hey!" Nyx protested at being looked down upon so badly. "I do have my hobbies, I'll have you know! I love cooking, for example. I could become an online chef. I also enjoy talking; I could see myself doing podcasts. But honestly, I'm most interested in becoming a strong awakened. Or a Valkyrie, I suppose, since we don't know if we were to awaken actually."

"Yes," he decreed firmly. I can't imagine others being my Valkyries, but I'm not going to just not have Valkyries because you refuse."

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Demonic Pornstar System
paragraphs: [The Supreme Demonic Sovereign System is the legacy of the Heavenly Demon, also known as the Celestial Tyrant. Before his imminent defeat, he used his last ounce of power to change the system and its core functions, which was necessary because the Supreme Demonic Sovereign System was created by the Heavenly Demon for his personal use, making it impossible to pass down to others. ]

[Furthermore, he equipped the system with another ability: upon the occurrence of a mana apocalypse, the system initiates a host selection process, scanning for compatible individuals and transforming into the ideal personalized system for the chosen host.]

[The Heavenly Demon wanted his successor to perfectly embody his beliefs before granting them his true powers. With the completion of the Hidden Quest, the host earned his initial recognition. He is the third to do so in the history of the system.]

[The system will henceforth refer to the host as the Successor, but for him to receive the Heavenly Demon's complete heritage, he will need to prove himself by ranking the system up to its maximum level. As a reward for completing the Hidden Quest, the Successor gained partial access to the class of the Heavenly Demon, as it was part of his legacy meant to be passed down to his successor.]

[The class Paragon of Sin can become one of the strongest classes in the universe, but the Heavenly Demon wanted to ensure that his successor was the right one before granting him full access to his class, forcing the system to keep the sins hidden behind its ranks. Each time the Successor ranks his Demonic Pornstar System up, he will gain access to a new sin. Starter sin: Wrath.]
[The Successor can further improve the sins available to him by leveling up, reaching bottlenecks, and surpassing them.]
[Despite the loss of the Pornstar class, the spell 'First-Person Camera' had been retained by turning it into a skill.]
[Valkyrie Sub-System -> Sinsworn Valkyrie Sub-System]

[Sinsworn Valkyries are the greatest supporters of the Paragon of Sin, his last bastion of defense and most fervent lovers. The Successor blesses members of the Sinsworn Valkyrie Sub-System with mightier powers than he could if the Valkyrie Sub-System hadn't evolved. The Successor has to think of a crest for his household members. The crest will mark his Sinsworn Valkyries in the form of a magical tattoo.]
[Declare to the whole world that they are his and no one else's!]
Heavenly Demon...? Legacy...? Successor...? Paragon of Sin...? Kaiden didn't know what to think, the information abruptly thrown at him was overwhelming.

The fact that he was the third to get to this point indicated that while he was appointed as the current successor, the succession was not set in stone. If Kaiden kept loafing around without progress, the system would likely leave in search of a new host. Kaiden didn't know what the criteria set by the Heavenly Demon were beyond being good to your lovers instead of being a hopeless hedonist, so the best he could do for now was to just continue doing what he felt was right.
As for the system's last statement, he was a bit on edge about it.'Is this mandatory?'
As always, his question was met with silence. The system was very clearly paying attention to him but lacked the ability or the intention to converse.

Although Kaiden didn't know what to think, he finally got a hint of what was going on. He had a myriad of theories swirling in his mind all this while, and at long last, he finally got the explanation, or at least a good portion of it.

If he was the successor of a legendary creature, then he was ready to embrace it. All he needed to know was that the end of the adventure wasn't the system turning hostile, and he firmly believed that not to be the case.
Moving on.
'They are extremely sexy girls who are the lovers of the man with the Paragon of Sin class, the successor of the Heavenly Demon... I mean, I just gotta, right?'
He quickly thought of a succubus heart tattoo.
Once he was finished, a new message popped up.
[Which part of their body would the Successor like to mark with his crest?]
'Their lower abdomen, right above the womb.'
"Agh!" Nyx yelped, followed by the other two. They reached for their bellies with a pained expression.
"What's going on?!" Luna asked with a strong grimace.
"Kai, I'm scared...!" Aria cried, looking for comfort.
"I'm sorry, I didn't know it would hurt. The system told me to mark you. It should be over soon." Kaiden was worried, there was no mention of pain in the text.
"It's not that bad... just overly warm as if a fire was burning inside me..." Nyx murmured weakly while pulling her shirt up to see what was going on. The rest did the same.
"... Kaiden Grey, explain yourself!" Luna hissed ominously, using his full legal name while she was eyeing her womb tattoo with pure disbelief evident on her delicate features.

The man in question awkwardly rubbed his chin while eyeing the three alluring bellies of his Sinsworn Valkyries. He had to give it to himself; the mark was phenomenal. All of them looked extremely hot with this new addition.
"Yeah, I'm sorry about it. Here, read over the new messages I received."
He summoned his status windows forth, letting them read everything he did. It took them a few minutes to voice their thoughts. "This is... Badass." Nyx murmured with much excitement.
"Yeah, but the womb tattoo... Kai, are you a pervert?" Aria asked bashfully.

"Of course he is! He became a pornstar just to hump hot girls and get paid while doing so! Instead of that question, what we should be asking is why you thought marking us with a womb tattoo was within your rights! Mark our ankles with a small dot, bastard!" Luna was quite furious.

"Did you skip language classes, miss? Your comprehension is lacking. Kaiden was meant to mark us as his, if the tattoo was small or in a place no one looks at, then what's the point?" Nyx spoke up in his defense, earning a thankful look from Kaiden. Though, he couldn't fault Luna either. She was completely right. After all...
"I did it because it felt right."

chapters.title: Chapter 43: Badass Valkyries
paragraphs: "Then I forgive you, Kai!" Aria chirped merrily. The silver-haired beauty seemed to not care too much.
"Thank you. Check your systemic interface. I wonder if you got a power." Kaiden did his best to move the topic along before the gamer girl started slinging fists at him instead of mere curses.
"Oh! I did. I awakened!" Nyx squealed with pure joy. "Space Valkyrie, it sounds very badass! However... It only has one spell."

Having one spell upon awakening often meant that the class would be F-tier once evaluated by the artifact in the Awakened Assocation. Each time an awakened reached a bottleneck, the first of which would happen at level 25, they would face a challenge. If they pass, the class will gain new abilities. However, there's a good reason for the tiering of the classes and why they were so important to decide one's ceiling as a combatant.

While low-tier awakened could put up a fight against higher ones if they were either higher leveled or just much better combatants, the higher-tiered people would gain better rewards, such as more or stronger spells, giving them giant innate advantages over the lower tiers.
"Moon Valkyrie! It sounds so beautiful; I love it so much." Aria was not at all disturbed by the fact that she also only had a single skill based on her ethereal, happy smile.

"Storm Valkyrie... You overgrown pink bimbo; you just dissed my language skills, yet you failed to read the added text. It says we will grow in strength alongside the Successor of the Heavenly Demon. When he ranks his Demonic Pornstar System up, we will gain new abilities. Furthermore, we can strengthen ourselves like normal awakened can by leveling up."

"Oh!" Nyx exhaled with surprise before swiftly checking the validity of Luna's statement. "You're right! This suggests that unlike normal awakened, we don't gain new spells by leveling up but by ranking up the Demonic Pornstar System. Levels for us mean upgrading our current spells as if our class is very strong already but is partially sealed away from us. Each rank-up puts us closer to the true potential of our Valkyrie classes and Kaiden to his Paragon of Sin class."
"A good theory," Kaiden nodded, thinking the same thing. "What are your spells?"
"Stormblade... Says I can summon a blade that's made of pure storm."
"Lunar Arc, a crescent-shaped energy projectile."
Both Luna and Aria had revealed their innate spells, and now it was time for Nyx to do so.
She had a mischievous grin tugging at her lips. "Master, open wide. [Telekinesis]."
Nyx focused her gaze on a salmon nigiri and started making motions with her fingers as if she were touching it despite the distance between her fingers and the sushi.

She dipped it in soy sauce, and once Kaiden realized what was going on and parted his lips, the piece of sushi was already floating in front of his mouth. She gently lay it down on his tongue while snickering with joy. The girl was very pleased with her spell.
"Master? Contain your deranged kinks, please," Luna grumbled.

The pink-haired beauty shook her head disapprovingly. "Don't you know? Valkyries are Odin's loyal subordinates. We don't know if Odin exists, however, the Heavenly Demon sure does—well, did, if he passed away. There are so many similarities between Odin and the Heavenly Demon that I think he might be the embodiment of the manmade concept known as 'Odin,' and as his successor, Kaiden is the new, up-and-coming 'Odin.'"
"What similarities? I never cared for mythology." Aria asked.

Nyx coughed into her palm before eagerly beginning her lecture session. "The first and most obvious is that both have an army of warrior maidens serving them, both 'coincidentally' called Valkyries. Second, Odin rules over Asgard and oversees other realms that are a part of his vast dominion. With the secondary epithet of 'Celestial Tyrant,' it's not at all a far fetch on my end to say that he must've had his dominion where he reigned supreme before his defeat.

Third, Odin is known for both war and wisdom. War should be obvious with titles like 'tyrant' and 'demon.' His wisdom, on the other hand, is best displayed by the fact that he created such an elaborate system. We don't have enough clues to validate my theory, I know, but I strongly believe myself to be right."
Nyx shocked all three listeners of hers. None of them expected her to be this smart and especially this knowledgeable about this niche topic.

The girl in question wasn't bothered by the three wide-eyed individuals staring at her with disbelief as she seamlessly continued with her reasonings. "The wording sense the system uses implies that Kaiden is our god and we are his angels or something along those lines. We derive everything supernatural that we have from him, and he can take it all away from us with a single thought of his. Furthermore, we already know that we will become stronger not just through leveling up but by making our 'god' increase his strength as well. In exchange, he will bless his devoted angels with more and more power as he grows."
"That's pretty hot..." Aria said bashfully once the three came out of their stupor. She seemed to not have any issues with Nyx's analogy and being subjected to being his warrior woman.
"You forgot your tinfoil hat at home, Miss Sub. Also, how do you know so much?" Luna asked before scoffing, "You're like a living Wikip*dia."

Nyx smugly snorted, "Hmph, you call me a bimbo and a bitch a lot, but I'll have you know, I'm a smart girl, and I like to read all kinds of stuff. I had a month where I got really into mythology when a romance book I read was about them, so I did a lot of research."

Kaiden interjected, offering his opinion. "You are my Valkyries, but I don't think I have anything to do with Odin or being a god in general. I think the Heavenly Demon was just an incomprehensibly strong dude who got bested at long last."

Nyx shook her head coyly, "We can't tell that for now. However, the wording the system uses makes me think that you will have more Sinsworn Valkyrie slots unlocked later down the line. At least, Odin surely had more than three Valkyries."
Luna suddenly grimaced with her beautiful features contorting from sheer disdain, "More slots mean opportunistic gold-digging sluts begging to occupy them..."
"Hm!" Aria gasped, realizing the possibility that there would be more members of the Valkyrie squad in the future.

Kaiden spoke up next, trying to be as diplomatic as possible. "We don't know what the future holds. Instead, we should form a plan. How are you ladies doing with money? I was thinking that if you need more, I would take Zadie's offer up on a few filmings."
"I'm good for this month," Luna replied instantly, clearly not happy with his proposed solution to their monetary troubles.
"I got enough for a while as well," Aria nodded.
"Yeah, a few weeks for me too."
"Then we should begin planning our future moves in earnest. Are there any roles you girls would prefer?"

chapters.title: Chapter 44: The Relationship
paragraphs: "I could be the social media manager. We need to have a team page on Insta and the like to promote ourselves and grow a proper fanbase! I can also cook our food until we get rich enough to hire a personal chef," Nyx suggested excitedly.
"I suppose I could be responsible for technological stuff. Unless you know a lot about them, Kaiden, I think I'm the best at it. Certainly not the two bimbos."

"First of all, I'm not a bimbo. As for the question, I don't know... honestly, I never had a lot of free time to learn skills like these." A sudden light shined in Aria's beautiful eyes as she thought of something. "Oh, I know! I could be the makeup artist and the girls' personal trainer. Both of you could use some exercise, and that's an objective fact, not me being rude. I would happily train you too, Kai, but..."
"Yeah, I'll stick with Liam for a bit longer. We are having too much success," he nodded.
"Don't worry about it. I'm sure he is much better for your progress than I could be..." Aria said dejectedly.

Kaiden smiled, "I only spend two hours a week with him as my trainer, I would be overjoyed if we could train together beyond that. Furthermore, who knows what will happen after we gain a few levels? By then, we will surely outgrow training regiments made by non-awakened humans."
"Okay!" Aria cheered but then turned sad instantly. "Guys... I don't know if I can move in with you. I'm the sole caretaker of my younger siblings."

"Hmm..." Kaiden pondered for a second, but seeing that the silver-haired supermodel didn't elaborate further, he could only accept that she didn't wish to talk about it for now. "What about you, Luna, Nyx?"
"I can move in at any time," Nyx informed him. "I live alone in a rental studio, and I would happily give up on it for a party house."
All eyes turned to Luna, who was deep in thought for a few seconds before she steeled her resolve.

"I starred in today's filming because I was forced to by my brother. I feared that he truly meant it when he said he would sell me out to his bosses. Even in this situation, I was trying my best to give him the benefit of the doubt, which was stupid, I know... But since meeting you all yesterday, my eyes have been opened. I realized that the kind of atmosphere we have going on between the four of us is what my heart needs, not the depressing aura of that dreadful place I used to call 'home.' I want to pack my stuff and live with you guys."
Nyx and Aria weren't privy to her backstory, but they both got the gist of it through contextual clues evidenced by their grim expressions.
"What about his demands of $5,000 a month?" Kaiden asked.

"I will give him what he wants a couple of times. Maybe 30,000 total. After all, he did work tirelessly to provide for me over the years, so I will repay him the amount he's owed. I don't want to feel indebted, but unless he gets on his knees and begs for forgiveness, I will not think of him as family but as the guy who forced me to almost sell my soul, which is what would've happened had I not met you."
Kaiden nodded at her reasoning and then spoke up.

"It's settled, then. Luna and Nyx will move in with me. Nyx, you should head home and pack your stuff. I will help you move tomorrow. For now, I want to go with Aria and check on her situation to get a better understanding, if that's alright with you?" he asked while glancing at the athletic beauty.
"S-sure, but my house is not very clean..." Aria agreed apprehensively, worried she'd leave a bad impression once he stepped foot into her home.

"Don't worry about it. Once Nyx has moved in, I propose we register at the Awakened Association and, soon after, visit our first dungeon. We will also begin to look for a place starting today. We need an affordable family-sized apartment, or we will make each other go crazy. Privacy is important even in close relationships. In the meantime, we will try to make money to get all of you out of trouble."
"Now that you say it, what is our relationship exactly?" Aria asked.
"Yeah, you didn't answer Aria's earlier confession. Not cool, Kaiden..." Nyx teased.
The girl in question blinked embarrassedly while cutely stealing glances at him.

"I consider all of you to be equally important to me. I will not play favorites, or what we have will soon turn sour. So, Aria, I'm sorry, but until Nyx and Luna also wish to be my lovers, I want all of us to remain as we are."

Kaiden knew that if he had taken one of them as a girlfriend while the other two remained as his kind of friends with benefits/friendly colleagues, the current harmony they shared would soon be ruined.

In his harem, he didn't want to have a main wife—a queen bee, so to speak. As far as Kaiden was concerned, he was already the luckiest man alive to have a chance at having a harem of such beautiful girls. If he began playing favorites, it felt like he would be spitting in the faces of the wonderful existences who agreed to accept him as their shared man.
"I don't mind being your lover. After all, you're my god and master now," Nyx stated coyly, though it was hard to determine if she was jesting or not.
"I can also... I can also be your girlfriend... If you want it so much...!" Luna muttered with great difficulty.

He examined the two for a while before accepting their words and clapping his palms together decisively. "Then, from today on, I'm the lover of the three most beautiful women on planet Earth," Kaiden announced happily.

Yes, Nyx wasn't smitten by him yet, but she had a very favorable impression of Kaiden for sure, and they would be living and working together, which included having steamy sex, so their relationship wouldn't be very different if they went from being friends to lovers. Maybe if he took her on romantic dates and such, she would fall for him all the way. Or perhaps, in her case, a badass dungeon-clearing session would be better. They could finish the day by mating on top of a defeated dragon's corpse.
'Sounds hot.'

Meanwhile, Vespera was sitting in the comfortable backseat of her luxury sedan as it sped down the highway. She could get around with her powers effortlessly, but she liked to be driven around. It reminded her of the simpler times when she was nothing more than the top executive of her family's conglomerate.
"You did the right thing, Vespera," Her elderly servant, who has taken care of the woman since birth as if she were her real mother, voiced her thoughts while driving the car.
"... The right thing?" The Monarch of Shadows repeated the servant's words coldly. "I just disowned my beloved son."
"You did it because it was the best choice for all parties involved. Kaiden also hated living in your home, you know that."

Vespera reluctantly accepted her reasoning, "I do." However, she wasn't done. "Yet I'm still the woman who brought him into this cruel world, and now I threw my innocent baby away as if he were defective, and I was ashamed of him."

Seeing that her words weren't having much effect on the grieving mother, the old lady sighed. Her heart was heavy, too, for she'd known Kaiden since he was a baby. "As I said, you did the right thing, and that's what matters."
"Hitler also believed he was doing the right thing."
