I don't want to feel indebted, but unless he gets on his knees and begs for forgiveness, I will not think of him as family but as the guy who forced me to almost sell my soul, which is what would've happened had I not met you."
Kaiden nodded at her reasoning and then spoke up.
"It's settled, then.
Luna and Nyx will move in with me.
Nyx, you should head home and pack your stuff.
I will help you move tomorrow.
For now, I want to go with Aria and check on her situation to get a better understanding, if that's alright with you?" he asked while glancing at the athletic beauty.
"S-sure, but my house is not very clean..." Aria agreed apprehensively, worried she'd leave a bad impression once he stepped foot into her home.
"Don't worry about it.
Once Nyx has moved in, I propose we register at the Awakened Association and, soon after, visit our first dungeon.
We will also begin to look for a place starting today.
We need an affordable family-sized apartment, or we will make each other go crazy.
Privacy is important even in close relationships.
In the meantime, we will try to make money to get all of you out of trouble."
"Now that you say it, what is our relationship exactly?" Aria asked.
"Yeah, you didn't answer Aria's earlier confession.
Not cool, Kaiden..." Nyx teased.
The girl in question blinked embarrassedly while cutely stealing glances at him.
"I consider all of you to be equally important to me.
I will not play favorites, or what we have will soon turn sour.
So, Aria, I'm sorry, but until Nyx and Luna also wish to be my lovers, I want all of us to remain as we are."

Kaiden knew that if he had taken one of them as a girlfriend while the other two remained as his kind of friends with benefits/friendly colleagues, the current harmony they shared would soon be ruined.
In his harem, he didn't want to have a main wife—a queen bee, so to speak.
As far as Kaiden was concerned, he was already the luckiest man alive to have a chance at having a harem of such beautiful girls.
If he began playing favorites, it felt like he would be spitting in the faces of the wonderful existences who agreed to accept him as their shared man.
"I don't mind being your lover.
After all, you're my god and master now," Nyx stated coyly, though it was hard to determine if she was jesting or not.
"I can also...
I can also be your girlfriend...
If you want it so much...!" Luna muttered with great difficulty.
He examined the two for a while before accepting their words and clapping his palms together decisively.
"Then, from today on, I'm the lover of the three most beautiful women on planet Earth," Kaiden announced happily.

Yes, Nyx wasn't smitten by him yet, but she had a very favorable impression of Kaiden for sure, and they would be living and working together, which included having steamy sex, so their relationship wouldn't be very different if they went from being friends to lovers.
Maybe if he took her on romantic dates and such, she would fall for him all the way.
Or perhaps, in her case, a badass dungeon-clearing session would be better.
They could finish the day by mating on top of a defeated dragon's corpse.
'Sounds hot.'
Meanwhile, Vespera was sitting in the comfortable backseat of her luxury sedan as it sped down the highway.
She could get around with her powers effortlessly, but she liked to be driven around.
It reminded her of the simpler times when she was nothing more than the top executive of her family's conglomerate.
"You did the right thing, Vespera," Her elderly servant, who has taken care of the woman since birth as if she were her real mother, voiced her thoughts while driving the car.
The right thing?" The Monarch of Shadows repeated the servant's words coldly.
"I just disowned my beloved son."
"You did it because it was the best choice for all parties involved.
Kaiden also hated living in your home, you know that."
Vespera reluctantly accepted her reasoning, "I do." However, she wasn't done.
"Yet I'm still the woman who brought him into this cruel world, and now I threw my innocent baby away as if he were defective, and I was ashamed of him."
Seeing that her words weren't having much effect on the grieving mother, the old lady sighed.
Her heart was heavy, too, for she'd known Kaiden since he was a baby.
"As I said, you did the right thing, and that's what matters."
"Hitler also believed he was doing the right thing."

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Alice Ashborn
paragraphs: Vespera's drive soon pulled into their mansion's parking space, and Elizabeth, her servant, opened the door for her with a minor bow.

The Monarch of Shadows then slowly walked up the stairs, took a left, then a right turn in the luxurious hallways adorned by incalculably expensive paintings and sculptures until she was greeted by an out-of-place pink, girly door that was decorated by drawings of flowers and cute animals.
It had a giant 'DO NOT DISTURB!' sign on it.
Vespera took a deep breath to calm herself and prepare to faceher.
*Knock knock knock*
She firmly tapped her knuckles on the eccentrically decorated door.
"Leave me alone!" A feminine cry welcomed her gesture with a coarse voice. She had been audibly bawling her eyes out for a long while.
"It's me," Vespera said.
The room's occupant didn't respond for a good ten minutes. The mother stood in place motionlessly as she patiently waited.
"Is it done...?" a soft, barely audible whisper that has lost all its edge asked. Its owner had moved close to the door based on the proximity of her weak voice.
"Yes."

Another silence ensued save for the girl's renewed wailing, but she finally opened the door after a while, revealing a short female that had lush black hair ending in adorable twintails. She rushed out of the door and dashed into Vespera's embrace with a force that would've easily sent a commoner straight to the afterlife upon impact, but the Shadow Monarch didn't even flinch.
The black-haired woman did her best not to show emotions as she began petting Alice's head and hugging her daughter with her other hand.
Alice nestled her head into Vespera's bosom and allowed her mother's jacket to act as her tear-storing tissue since she was crying her heart out at the moment.
"I will never abandon my big brother, no matter if he's legally my brother or not!" Alice decreed a few minutes later once she managed to calm down enough to hold a conversation.
"I know."

"You better disown me too because if any of my so-called 'family members' attempt to hurt Kai even after you went this far, I will murder them in cold blood and burn this cursed mansion down with all of us still in it." Her statement was uttered in the same cold, lifeless tone the public knew Vespera to speak, and there was not even a shred of doubt in the mother's mind that her daughter would do exactly as she promised.

Alice was the youngest of the five siblings at age 16, with Kaiden being the second oldest at 22. Despite the age gap and gender difference, he was the only one who played with the twintailed girl throughout her childhood, the one who treated her like a cherished younger sister. Nothing more, nothing less, and that meant the whole world to the girl.

In a household like this, competition was rampant even before the mana apocalypse's arrival upended human society. Her twin older brothers and elder sister acted exactly as one would expect; they were treating her as a rival, always looking to throw their youngest sibling under the bus by any means necessary, yet Kaiden did none of that. He happily played with her for hours on end as they acted out her dumb romance stories with her barbie dolls, he read her nighttime tales from her favorite books and even took her on walks to the park and other interesting places like the cinemas and the zoo. All her most cherished memories had Kaiden included in them.
What's more, her big brother had never asked for anything in return. Kaiden genuinely wanted his little sister to smile and be happy.

The young girl's heart was pained like never before when her big brother fell into a deep depression due to not awakening in a prodigious family full of awakeners, and just like her mother, Alice was also happy in a way that he moved out of this suffocating place. However, neither of them expected the man to give up on a normal non-awakened career like that of an economist to just say 'screw it' and become a pornstar.

Yes, Alice was also aware of his decision. Vespera had continuously shared the less explicit results of her spying efforts with her daughter. The black-haired girl wasn't at all happy with her brother's choice of career.
She also did her reconnaissance on social media, but Kaiden rarely posted anything at all.

When she saw him post multiple times about a certain video game, Alice tried her best at it so that she could reach his rank and snipe (play with) him without Kaiden knowing that it was her in his game supporting him to destroy the enemies, but it was far too complex of a game for a non-gamer like her, so she was in the midst of getting online coached by the top 1 ranked player of the server for six hours every day, Sundays included.

As for why she didn't contact him directly? Alice believed that he wanted to get away from anything and everything Ashborn, and she was one of them. Seeing her would likely make him remember all the negative emotions he associates with the name, even if she were to throw it all away.

Vespera's grip on her daughter's back tightened as she uttered the next few words through gritted teeth with rarely seen, deeply boiling fury in her tone. "You won't have to do any of that, for if they dare make an attempt on his life, I'll bury the remains of their desecrated corpses myself."
"Say cheese!" Nyx instructed while she held her phone in her hand and snapped a few selfies with all four of them in the frame.

As the member responsible for their social media presence, it was up to the pink-haired beauty to snap some good photos to be used as their profile picture. They decided to create a team page under the name 'Valhalla's Sinners.'
It took some deliberation between the four members to arrive at this name. Sadly, Kaiden's preferred handle— Kaiden's Sexy Sinners—was unanimously rejected.
The debate was between Valhalla and Sinners mostly.
Valhalla was thematically fitting for the Valkyrie Sub-System, and Nyx also insisted that he was their Odin, so it was sort of a no-brainer group name to select.
Sinners, on the other hand, was fitting due to the group being led by the Paragon of Sin and the fact that they planned to rise to stardom through unconventional, shameless methods.
Ultimately, they decided on the best of both worlds, that being Valhalla's Sinners.
He opened his status window to check his progress.

[Rank: 1 - Wannabe]
[Class: Paragon of Sin]
{Stats}
{Vitality: 11}
{Strength: 12}
{Agility: 11}
{Endurance: 12}
{Mana: 10}
{Magic: 10}
[Views: 0]
[Fangirls: 1]
[Income: 9]
[Sinsworn Valkyries]
< Luna Aster >
< Aria Levander >
< Nyx Cosmos >
[Skills]
1. [Monster Girl Subjugator] (S-tier)
2. [Immune Cock] (D-tier)
3. [Remove Her Inhibitions] (E-tier)
4. [First-Person Camera] (F-tier)
It seemed that abilities from his class did not show up here. After all, only his system showed this much information. A normal person's status window would be like this.
[Name: John Doe]
[Class: Warrior]
[Level: 1]
{Stats}
{Vitality: 10}
{Strength: 10}
{Agility: 10}
{Endurance: 10}
{Mana: 10}
{Magic: 10}
That's it.

As for the value of stats, Kaiden's numbers were great. The effort he put in during the past month showed. The average adult male had 10 in the four physical ones, and the average woman had 8. The record for the highest stat as a level 1 was held by a Russian strongman who awakened as an adult. He had 18 Vitality, 19 Strength, 8 Agility, and 14 Endurance. Thus, 19 was thought to be the peak non-awakened physical stat one could earn through sheer effort.
The fact that Kaiden had 12 in two and 11 in two other stats showed that he was way above average, which showed in his almost supernaturally quickly growing muscles.
With their meal concluded and their excitement over the otherworldly happenings that went down one after the other in rapid succession slowly dwindling, they decided to leave the sushi restaurant.
Nyx and Luna wanted to move into his little dorm room, while Aria would come later due to her responsibilities at her home.
To that end, the pink-haired girl went home to pack her things and notify the landlord that she would be moving out.
Luna rightfully despised her brother, so she wanted to wait until he was out on a dungeon clear in a few days to move her stuff, so she would be staying in his dorm already.

However, instead of staying with her, Kaiden decided to accompany Aria to her home after receiving her permission. He was most worried about his silver-haired girlfriend since he didn't know much about her situation. It was time to change that.
The pair called a ride and soon found themselves on the way to their destination.
"Sorry for barging into your home like this," Kaiden broke the silence with a sincere apology.

Aria glanced at him surprisedly, blinked rapidly in clear confusion, and then realized that her silence made him think she didn't want him here. "N-no, not at all! I'm glad that you are coming with me, Kai! It's just I was daydreaming."
"About?"
"... I have a boyfriend now!" she revealed the secret she'd been mulling about in the past few minutes with an energetic cheer.
"You don't say?!" Kaiden shouted sarcastically. "Who is the lucky guy? I'll beat him up, he is too fortunate for his own good."
"..." The silver-haired bombshell pouted adorably as she puffed her cheeks and refused to meet his gaze. "You're poking fun at me."
"I wouldn't dare."
"Hmph...!"
The rest of the ride was spent with Kaiden trying to lessen his gorgeous girlfriend's heavy pouting. He was successful in the end, but it took a good five minutes of concentrated effort.

He did have a strong suspicion tugging in the back of his mind that Aria was only pretending to be angry with him so that she could enjoy the way he pampered her with rosy words, but he happily accommodated her needs without complaints or accusations.
Once they stepped out of the vehicle, Kaiden couldn't help but frown. They'd arrived at a horribly downtrodden part of the city.
Just from a single glance, he could count a dozen homeless bums sitting in the shades offered by the various homes while some were rummaging through garbage bins in search of leftovers.
The homes themselves were also heavily in desperate need of renovation, but he could guess that a fancy home was the least of the worries of the people living here.
"It's not a place to live as a young, attractive woman, Aria. We should be thankful that you weren't assaulted already."

To his surprise, Aria began giggling. "Hehehe... Your golden spoon is showing, young master. In places like this, people are always watching, so committing such a high-profile crime is a rarity. However, you must know exactly where you can and can't be. The main street is safe, especially since police patrol this road constantly. During the night you can even ask them to escort you to your home, that's what I've been doing. I do seriously appreciate you worrying about me, though! It's very sweet."

Aria finished her answer by firmly squeezing his hand to reinforce the truth of how much she appreciated him worrying about her. Kaiden didn't like being labeled as a rich brat, but he knew very well that he was out of his element here. If a native to this part of town said so, who was he to argue?
"Here we are..." Aria revealed a minute or so later. Her tone was low, hushed. It didn't take a genius to pick up on the fact that she was ashamed to be living where she did.

Kaiden would never think badly of her for such a reason, but he understood why she wasn't keen on showing off her home to her newly acquired boyfriend. To say that it was in rough condition would be putting it gently. That's like saying Vespera wasn't a control freak—an outrageous lie.

Its peeling paint, boarded-up windows, and crumbling brickwork told tales of decades of neglect. Trash bins sat next to the door, and the crumbling pathway leading to her door was littered with scattered garbage and broken bottles.
It wasn't a family home but something like a crack den, or so Kaiden thought.

His first impression deepened his unease upon gaining entry. The floors were worn, with visible dust collecting everywhere, while the old furniture and dirty walls articulated the severity of her situation. A single bare bulb swung from the ceiling, which rather reluctantly lit up a few seconds after Aria flipped the switch.

Seeing his wry expression, Aria began pleading with a begging tone. "I'm not a lazy girl; please don't think that, Kai! It's just that I never had the energy to clean after finishing work, and in the last few days, I was in deep depression due to the upcoming filming." The girl was very anxious about what kind of opinion he would form of her upon seeing this sad, depressing sight.
Kaiden shook his head gently. "Don't worry about it, Aria. Where are your siblings? I wanna introduce myself, and then we could clean up together if you're down."
"Brother went out to sell weed," A third, high-pitched feminine voice spoke up suddenly.

chapters.title: Chapter 47: Babysitting
paragraphs: Kaiden turned his head toward the direction of the new voice and saw a small teen emerge from a room beyond the lounge area.
She had the same silver-colored hair as Aria and bore a strong resemblance to the woman in general, though she was much less developed. Kaiden guessed her age to be around 12.
"He did what?!" Aria asked angrily. "I told him to stop; he'll ruin his future!"
As if fate wanted to prove her right, her phone rang with a comical timing. She picked it up, and her face went pale immediately. "Yes. Yes... Argh... I'll be right there."
Once her call was finished, she exhaled a long, tired sigh. "That little brat got caught with weed in his pocket. I'll have to go to the police station as his legal guardian."
"Is it serious?"
"No, he only had a very small amount on him... They'll likely let him off the hook with a slap on the wrist."
"Good, can I help?" Kaiden wanted to be of assistance because he believed Aria to already have more than enough on her plate, she didn't need a rebellious teen to act out against her.
"No, I'll deal with it..." his girlfriend shook her head but then paused, thinking of something. Aria uncertainly muttered, "Could I maybe..."
Seeing her reluctance to finish her sentence, Kaiden nudged her along. "Yes?"

Feeling how badly he wanted to help her, Aria breathed a sigh of relief and smiled at him warmly before elaborating, "Back when I worked in the bar, I used to hire a babysitter for the night, but I told her not to come when I quit. She won't make it on such short notice. Could you maybe watch over Lux?"
"I don't want..." it was the little sister who spoke up this time. She wasn't comfortable being left alone with an imposing adult man who was a complete stranger for very understandable reasons.

Aria smiled, "I didn't introduce you two yet. Kaiden, this is Lux, my much cherished younger sister. Lux, this is Kaiden, my handsome boyfriend. Although I only met him recently, I trust him a lot. He is an amazing guy."
Lux's eyelids fluttered wide open at the sudden and world-shattering revelation. She opened and closed her mouth repeatedly without a sound managing to escape her lips.

"Big sis has a boyfriend?!" she finally managed to squeal frantically while intently eyeing the man with newfound interest. Her previous inhibitions towards him as a person had immediately vanished, showing how much Lux trusted her sister's word.

"Yes!!" Aria squealed back with similar excitement levels, though she did calm down quickly as reality hit her with a cold slap, reminding her she had to go to the police station. "So, Kai, could I trouble you with this?"
"I would be glad to help."
"I don't know how long I'll be away; you might have to spend the night here..."

"No problem at all." Kaiden was not here for a booty call; he genuinely wanted to see what was going on in his lover's home life and if he could make it better somehow. Instead of being annoyed by the sudden 'task,' he was happy to be of assistance.
"Thank you!" Aria hugged him tightly for a good dozen seconds before quickly departing from the home, leaving Kaiden alone with Lux.

Kaiden did have a little sister back in the Ashborn residence, so he wasn't completely clueless as to how to deal with her, but this situation was vastly different. They were strangers and in a home that resembled a horrible crack den to boot. Trash was littered all across the place.
"Any plans for tonight, Lux?"
"No..." she replied shyly. Now that her big sister was no longer around, the young girl became a lot more reserved, especially since the rather tall Kaiden towered over her so ominously.
"What do you usually do in the evenings?"
"I chat with my friends on the phone."
"How about we do some cleaning?"
Lux winced while glancing at the stinking trashpiles. "Don't wanna..."
"You know that your sister is an amazing person, right? She deserves to come home to a clean place after all she'd done to keep this household going."

It was unreasonable to expect a young child to be responsible like that, so he didn't think her to be a freeloading, ungrateful girl or anything like that. However, Kaiden still wanted Aria to have at least this much comfort in her life.

"Yes..." Lux felt very guilty when he put things that way. She knew that the babysitter came at night because her sister was working even at that time to earn enough money, allowing Aria to remain their legal guardian instead of having the child protective services take them away from her.
"You know what, let's make a deal. If you help me clean this place, I'll take you out to eat dinner at whichever restaurant you prefer."
Her eyes immediately lit up with a greedy shine. "Really?! Even Mcd*nalds?!"

Kaiden couldn't help but chuckle amusedly. A child like her didn't have the developed tastebuds of an adult, so his offer, which could've seen him lose hundreds of dollars if she had gourmet tastes, ended up being just a dinner at a cheap fast food chain.
"Sure. You can get a Happy Meal with that toy gift in it."
To Kaiden's surprise, the little miss didn't like what she heard. "That's for kids! I'm a grown-up already!"
He did his utmost not to laugh at her declaration, worried Lux would take it as him looking down on her. No kid liked to be treated as one.

With that, the mood in the home turned energetic. The pair did their best to clean as much as they could, but it was entirely unrealistic to do a complete overhaul of this place in one go. That being said, they could at least make it more liveable. The pair started by hauling the already-filled trashbags to their intended dumping place, after which they did the dishes.
The sink was full of used plates, so Kaiden and Lux elected to use teamwork, with the man doing the scrubbing and the girl doing the wiping down and putting away parts of the task.
"So you like my big sister?" Lux asked curiously once they'd comfortably settled into the motions of the dishwashing process, and she was no longer afraid of Kaiden.
"Yes, very much so."
"What do you like about her?"

Kaiden could tell that she was just at the age where romance stuff interested her greatly. Her sister getting a boyfriend all of a sudden was big news, which no doubt occupied a great part of Lux's thought processes right now. She was fishing for more juicy details, and he happily accommodated her curiosity.

"Her beauty speaks for itself, she is one of the most gorgeous women I've ever seen, however, that's just the superficial stuff. Aria is an outstanding person who sacrificed a lot to provide for her loved ones, something that makes me admire her greatly. On top of that, she has a cheery personality, providing me with an abundance of joy from simply being around her. Her gorgeous smile makes my heart skip a beat every time she graces me with it."

"Hmm.... I see. So she's just one of the prettiest girls, not the prettiest?" Her question was laced with unsaid accusations. Lux couldn't believe that her beloved big sister was not the most beautiful woman in the eyes of her boyfriend.

chapters.title: Chapter 48: W-w-w-what?!
paragraphs: Kaiden flinched upon hearing her unimpressed tone. He debated for a bit about the best way to go about answering, but in the end, he decided there was no reason not to be honest. "Aria is the prettiest girl I'd ever seen, alongside my two other girlfriends."
The little sister's eyes almost bulged out of their sockets, and due to her sheer shock, she even dropped the fork she was busy wiping clean.

"W-w-w-what?!" Lux shouted from the top of her lungs. She couldn't believe this. Did this man just admit to cheating on her big sister? Why would he do that? Did he forget that she could—and would—snitch on him?

"She knows them both; they're pretty good friends, considering they met very recently," Kaiden revealed as he read the girl's inner thoughts like an open book. Lux was very expressive with her facial expressions, so it wasn't hard to do.
"... So you're not cheating on big sis... because she knows of the others and approves of them being with you?" The little miss asked after her confused brain started connecting the dots.

"Indeed," Kaiden nodded and chuckled upon seeing her completely flabbergasted expression. Lux looked like a girl whose entire world had been turned upside down. Her bewilderment was the perfect example of how modern Western society treated harems.

It took her jumbled head a few minutes to get over this universe-shattering news, after which Kaiden asked a personal question. "Could you tell me what happened to your parents? If it's painful to talk, then just remain silent, and I won't ask any questions related to them."

Lux shook her head, grabbed the fork she dropped, and resumed cleaning it while answering, "No, I don't mind talking about them. Father left before I was born, and mother is a drug addict who lost the... I forgot the word. She is not allowed to be our caretaker."
"Custody?"
"Yep!" Lux nodded once Kaiden guessed the hard word she couldn't remember.
"Shouldn't your father pay child support?"

"Uhm..." Lux began thinking inwardly while pointing a finger at her chin and glancing up at the ceiling. "I remember big sis saying something about him not having money but in reality just playing the system."

Although Kaiden couldn't be certain, he theorized that the father might've declared bankruptcy while, in reality, having income sources that were not exactly government-approved, and as a result, he couldn't be forced to pay up.
"What about your mother? Is she locked up in jail?" As a druggie, it could be one explanation for her lack of presence in her children's lives.
"No, she lives with her boyfriend a few streets away."
... Nevermind then.
"When did you see her last time?"
"Hm... Maybe a month ago? Mother is not doing very well; she is very thin, and I think her boyfriend is not a good person."
"Why would you say that?"
"I saw bruises on her face and neck, but when I asked what happened, she brushed me off."
Kaiden could tell that she had difficulty speaking about her mother, it was a topic that made her sad. He decided to ask the rest from Aria.

They spent about two hours around the house before stepping out to go to the fast food place. Kaiden wasn't keen on breaking his no-cheat day streak just yet—the ice cream he ate with Nyx on the day of the casting didn't count because he was doing everything in his power to cheer the pink-haired beauty up and to lessen her extreme amounts of anxiety—so he ate a salad while Lux stuffed her belly full with a Big M*c, fries, and cola.
"Can I get your number?" Lux asked while massaging her stuffed belly with a content smile adorning her lips.
They say this sort of food is good for comfort, which was very clearly true in her case, Kaiden noted.
"May I know what for?"
"To chat if I'm bored."

Kaiden thought it would look a bit weird if he was chat messaging with a girl a decade younger than him, but considering Lux was his girlfriend's younger sister, it was probably okay, so he typed it into her phone.

Once they got back to the house, the cleaning continued for another two hours, after which Kaiden offered to read her a book of her choice, but he wasveryfirmly informed about the fact that she was not a kid, so they said goodbyes and went to bed. He stayed overnight because Aria was still not back with her troublemaker younger brother.
Naturally, Kaiden slept in a different room. Lux showed him Aria's, so he lay down on her bed after a swift shower and quickly closed his eyes.

Today was the most tiresome day of his life. He shot three porno videos one after the other, got disowned, somehow found himself to be the boyfriend of three insanely hot and lovely girls, upgraded his garbage class to an ultra-badass one, and learned that he was the potential successor of a dude named Heavenly Demon who likely ruled over entire worlds. As if that wasn't tiresome enough, he ended the day by cleaning a crack den for four hours.
Kaiden slept peacefully like a baby until he was suddenly awoken in the middle of the night due to some fabric rustling.
He looked up and saw the silhouette of Aria, who tried to climb into the spot next to him as quietly as possible. "Hey."
She flinched for a moment before getting her bearings together. "Hey... sorry for waking you."
"Don't worry about it," Kaiden said in a gentle tone as he opened his arms wide apart invitingly.

Seeing that he was not at all frustrated despite getting awoken in the middle of the night, Aria sighed with relief and happily jumped into his embrace, after which she firmly hugged his torso with both hands.
She could be a very needy girl at times.
"I was floored when I stepped into the house. I can't believe you cleaned up to that degree!" Aria whispered her gratitude before lovingly nuzzling her face into his bare chest.
"I had a helper."
"You invited Luna over?"
"..." Kaiden couldn't believe what he was hearing. "No, I got your little sister to help me."
"..." It was Aria's turn to be shocked.
"That girl helped you of her own volition?!"
"I bribed her with food."
"... You offered her Mcd*nalds." Things finally fell into place in the silver-haired beauty's head as she revealed the results of her investigation in a cold tone.
Kaiden couldn't help but chuckle wryly. "Yeah... Based on your cold tone, I've done something I shouldn't have."

Aria firmly shook her head into his chest, "No, you're entirely innocent. It's that little rascal who I have an issue with. She is banned from fast foods; she used this rare opportunity to go behind my back and get her fill."

Oh. Kaiden couldn't help but chuckle amusedly. What a smart young lady. No wonder she chose that place when he offered a restaurant of her choice, Lux used the fact that her new babysitter wasn't informed of the 'dos and don'ts' to her advantage masterfully.
"I see. Did you manage to resolve the issue with the police?"
"Yeah, he was let off with a warning. They said it was the last time, though. If that dummy does this again, he is going straight to juvie."
"Want me to talk with him?"

paragraphs: "..." Aria thought about his offer while hugging him even closer. It was a difficult topic that ate away at her heart. After a bit, she shook her head, "Maybe a man's input would help Damian, but not tomorrow. He needs to cool his head off. I don't think he's in a state where he would be receptive to your words."

"You know best." Kaiden accepted her words while he grabbed her firm, athletic butt with one hand and her thigh with the other, after which he lifted her leg so that it rested on top of his lower abdomen. Although Aria was wearing a nightrobe, her silky smooth thighs were not covered entirely, so he could bask in their tender touch.
"Hehe! I'm a bit tired now... And you've already ejaculated like six times today..." Aria giggled cutely.
"I was just getting us comfy, nothing more."
"Hmm..." Aria's strong suspicions easily shone through her musing, but she let it go in the end.
"Since I'm not getting any action, can I ask about your parents? Lux told me a bit, but she wasn't very well informed."

The Moon Valkyrie sighed a long one before deciding to accommodate her boyfriend's request. She told him about her father, and Kaiden's bankruptcy theory proved to be exactly on the money. He was legally assetless and jobless thus, he couldn't be forced by the government to pay up.
"As for my mother... She is a drug addict who works as a clerk in a brothel to earn her fix."

Hearing this, Kaiden felt immense sorrow in his heart for his girlfriend. Just how difficult was her upbringing? "I must've seemed like an entitled brat when you learned of me being an Ashborn and throwing it away for something abstract like 'happiness.'"
Aria erupted into merry giggling and bumped him on the nose playfully before admitting slyly, "Maybe just a little bit."
"Just a bit? Your tone tells an entirely different story..."
"That kind of reasoning won't hold up in court, so you better give up!"

Kaiden couldn't help but laugh and be drawn to this lovely existence, so much so that he reached under Aria's chin, lifted her head, and dove in for a sensual kiss, which surprised the girl greatly, but she offered no resistance at all.
A few minutes later, once they detached their tongues, Kaiden asked another question that was on his mind. "What about your mother's boyfriend?"
"He's a pimp. He owns a brothel at which she works as the receptionist, and he is also the one who supplies her with the drugs."
Kaiden snorted, "Then he is a very bad influence on her."
"Yes, but I can't do anything about it. I begged my mother before to break up with him and visit a detox center, but she firmly refused me."

He could only sigh with a heavy heart. It seemed he would have to pay a visit to his future mother-in-law sometime and see if she was truly beyond help or not. For now, he could only hold his girl closer as they drifted off to sleep in each other's warm embrace.
Kaiden awoke feeling excellently rested. How could he not when such a hot babe was in his arms throughout the night?
Based on her soft breathing, Aria was still in deep slumber, so he decided to think a bit about things. With her sleeping position, he had no way to get out of bed without waking her.

The first thing on his mind was the Awakened Association. As newly awakened people, they were legally obligated to register at one of their centers within a week of awakening. It wouldn't be an issue normally, but not only did he have a weird class, but his three girls all had classes with the word Valkyrie in them. He didn't know what the reaction of the higher-ups of the association would be, but he had no way to circumvent the registration process.
The Awakened Association was an almighty organization. If he refused to register, that would be akin to lying to the IRS about your income, just with heavier penalties.
Kaiden was not at all ready to live as a fugitive, so he had to be honest and hope for the best. Weirder things have happened than this, so he hoped it would be okay.

Afterward, Kaiden thought about the future of their content creation enterprise. The four of them didn't have a lot of time to dwindle around; they had to upload videos and earn money, or the girls would be in financial trouble.

Kaiden wanted to start with something small and simple, like a sensual blowjob scene. They'd decided to entirely forego the internet for their adult content and focus solely on the awakened media platform. It would result in the best long-term earnings since it was the most approachable, and they wanted to have sole ownership over the videos, which was something they would not have if they uploaded them to the internet. Anyone could download and spread them, even edit them.

Since the four of them didn't have money to get good mana cameras yet, they would have to depend on his First-Person Camera skill, which was transformed from his Pornstar class's spell to the Demonic Pornstar System's skill when he changed classes.

Their other content would most certainly include dungeon-clearing streams as well as Luna's gaming stuff, the latter of which would be on Tw*tch and Yo*tube. Other than that, things were undecided, but Kaiden wanted variety to be certainly among the categories they produced, such as going to the beach, cooking and eating together, fun competitions, etc.

He also thought about Nyx and how he would be helping her move today. With Aria's and Luna's situation more or less unveiled, now Nyx was the only girl of his whose backstory and reasons for volunteering for the casting remained a mystery.
Lastly, it was time they began clearing a beginner-friendly dungeon, but that would have to wait until their registration was complete with the association.
Since the sleeping beauty was still clinging onto him with so much neediness, Kaiden didn't have the heart to tear her off, so he remained in bed and took his phone out.
He saw a few messages.
The first one was from Nyx.

- Kaiden: I'll say this only once, so listen well. Don't you dare call any of them by such demeaning names. None of them are purchasable. The next time you do, I'll beat you up.
A few hours ago, David's room.
"Babe, I can't sleep like this..." Becky whined.
"You're not alone..." David grunted.
*Bang! Bang! Bang!*

Someone heavily banged their fists against the desk in his neighbor's room. David was sure it wasn't Kaiden because he knew the man very well, and he wasn't one to rage like this, especially not at 3:40 AM.
However, what truly solidified his belief that it wasn't Kaiden causing the ruckus was the high-pitched feminine screeching that accompanied the banging noises.
"Help me already, boosted fuckers!!! I'm playing 1v3 over here!!!"

David had enough. He dressed up in his clothes and went to knock on Kaiden's door. It took a few minutes for the occupant to answer, and when she did, he recognized one of the three hookers he saw with Kaiden not long ago.
"What do you want?" she grunted, very frustrated even now due to whatever irked her in the game.
"You to be quiet."
"Don't wanna."
"..." David was taken aback at her instant refusal. It wasn't exactly an outrageous thing to ask in a dorm where students lived to study efficiently.
"Is that all? I'm busy."
David had a vein bulge on his forehead. The audacity of this woman was something else.
"You are playing LoL, right?"
"Yep."
"Let's make a bet with a 1v1 duel."
"Hmm?"
"If I win, you turn off the computer immediately—no, scratch that. Do you accept customers?" After seeing how extremely smoking hot this girl was, David wasn't feeling overly loyal to Becky.

However, much to his surprise, the short girl's eyes darkened to a very threatening degree as her entire face contorted to one of pure anger. "This is the second time you insinuate that I'm a whore. Do it one more time, and I swear that I will ruin your life."
"Huh? Aren't you?" David asked confusedly.

"No, genius! Kaiden is my boyfriend; I never had a lover before him. He isn't even here, what kind of a call girl stays in her customer's home to play video games when the customer isn't there?! Use your brain a bit, would you? Aren't you a smart uni student?"
David had to scratch his chin a bit in embarrassment. She did bring up a good point. "My apologies, then. I just can't accept that such a loser pulled a hot girl like you."
"I don't care at all whether accept it or not. What was it you said about a 1v1?"
"Oh, yeah. If I win, you turn off the computer and never repeat this night routine of yours during weekdays."
"Ok. If I win, I want $500."
David had to replay in his head what this girl had just uttered from her rosy lips. "Are you insane? The wager is not at all balanced."

"Hmm..." Luna thought a bit inwardly before nodding to herself. "Alright, beyond what we already agreed upon, I will also introduce you to a 19-year-old friend of mine. She is a natural blonde beauty with big breasts. Her boyfriend cheated on her a few days ago, so she could use a manly shoulder to cry on."
"Deal!" his response was instantaneous. David wasn't strapped for cash, so it seemed to be a worthy wager to undertake in his mind.
With the wager settled, he eagerly rushed back to his dorm room and turned the computer on.
"Baby, what are you doing...?" Becky asked in a tired voice.
"Not now! I have to put a bitch in her place."
David had recently ranked up to the Gold rank, so he was very confident in his chances.

He had three ranks of players who were much worse than him. Furthermore, he knew that almost all girls played exclusively heal/shield support characters who were bad in 1v1s, so the advantage was definitely on his side.
A new notification arrived, the beauty from next door had just invited him to a private game. David smugly clicked on her profile to check her rank.
However, his eyes immediately bulged outward to an unnatural degree as his heart skipped multiple beats.
The rank that welcomed him on her profile was none other than...
Grandmaster.
